blocks.text: Deportation centers are legally contentious, expensive and the subject of political controversy: For years, Brussels has been grappling with the issue of establishing such centers outside the EU for rejected asylum seekers. Previous attempts have failed due to legal objections, but now, a “group of five” consisting of Greece, Germany, Austria, Denmark and the Netherlands believes it has overcome these hurdles. During an interview with the Greek television channel ANT1, Greece’s Minister of Migration, Thanos Plevris, stated that the first of these so-called “return hubs” is scheduled to begin operations as early as the second half of 2027 — just in […]...
